messages.subject: Re: iplots error on Mac
messages.body_plain:
Luo,

due to changes in Leopard that essentially prevent Java applications  
with UI to co-operate with other GUIs you have to use JGR to run  
iPlots on Mac OS X 10.5.
There are ways to get past the error you're seeing (using threaded  
rJava), but the result soon leads to deadlocks, because Leopard  
abandoned non-blocking event model, so Java events and GUI events will  
starve each other. By using JGR which runs a native Java GUI you don't  
have that problem.

Cheers,
Simon

messages.subject: Re: rJava namespace load failed
messages.body_plain:
Tobias,

it seems as if rJava cannot find the jvm library. Please make sure you  
have it installed (see the instructions at
http://jgr.markushelbig.org/JGR_on_Linux.html
Also have a look in /usr/lib/jvm/java-6-sun-1.6.0.06/jre, looking for  
libjvm.so
If you find it, try ldd ...libjvm.so to see whether you are missing  
some dependencies.
Let me know how it goes, I don't have any Ubuntu 8 machine around, but  
I could create a virtual one for testing ... any other Ubuntu 8 users  
here?

Cheers,
Simon

as the getType() function in REXP.java is deprecated I guess I need to determine the type using the is...() functions. Is there any 'good' way in doing so, e.g. first checking for matrix/vector and then checking for string/numeric?

I might maybe check the first bytes of the RAW stream but maybe there is something better.

Thanks in advance,

Andreas
